name: task_status
description: Show status of all asynchronously spawned tasks: task_id (truncated to 19 characters in the table — take the full id from the `[task_id=...]` header or from `task_audit`), agent, model, current state (running/completed/failed), and each task's latest live progress/checkpoint snapshot, without blocking. Finished tasks' output is included inline and collected immediately, so you can use results without calling task_wait.
